# nautobot_tenant_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves information about all tenant groups in Nautobot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// This fetches all known tenant groups
data "nautobot_tenant_groups" "all" {}

output "data_tenant_groups_example" {
  value = data.nautobot_tenant_groups.all.tenant_groups[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tenant_groups` (Attributes List) List of tenant groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenant_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--tenant_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tenant_groups`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Tenant group's creation date (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Tenant group's description.
- `display` (String) Human friendly display value for the tenant group.
- `id` (String) Tenant group's UUID.
- `last_updated` (String) Tenant group's last update date (RFC3339).
- `name` (String) Tenant group's name.
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the tenant group.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the tenant group.
- `parent_id` (String) UUID of the parent tenant group.
- `url` (String) URL of the tenant group.
